method: Exact installed JAR resources and javap bytecode inspection; this file is evidence, not a gameplay owner.

damage_pipeline.expression: native spell level/power expression -> SpellDamageEvent -> JEM world-tier factor for non-PvP player casts -> Human direct-hit +1 when applicable -> Iron school resistance -> ordinary LivingEntity mitigation
damage_pipeline.armor_contract: Spell damage types are members of neoforge:is_magic; the installed JAR does not add them to minecraft:bypasses_armor.

beam_candidates.native_damage_expression: 0.5 * spell_power; SunbeamEntity applies the hit at its native delayed hit point

acquisition.variant_key: spell ID and level in ItemStack data
acquisition.fact: The exact installed JAR uses irons_spellbooks:randomize_spell in many chest and entity loot tables, including school-filtered mob drops.
acquisition.conclusion: The registry item ID alone cannot identify the reported spell or prove its rarity/level. ItemStack NBT/components or the exact localized spell name is required.
